 Print IBPS Clerk Preliminary result 2026 expected soon; check result date, website and next stage IBPS Clerk Result 2026 : The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) is expected to announce the Clerk Preliminary Examination Result 2026 in November. Candidates who appeared for the Common Recruitment Process for Customer Service Associates (CRP CSA-XVI) are awaiting the result announcement. The preliminary examination was conducted on October 10 and 11, 2026. As of today, IBPS has not confirmed November 20 as the result declaration date. The result is expected during the final weeks of November, according to examination updates. Candidates will be able to check their qualifying status through the official website, ibps.in, once the result link becomes active. IBPS Clerk result 2026: Examination and vacancy details The recruitment process is being conducted for Customer Service Associate positions in participating public sector banks. The preliminary examination serves as the screening stage, and candidates who qualify will be eligible to appear for the Main examination. According to the IBPS examination calendar, the CSA-XVI Main examination is scheduled for December 27, 2026. The preliminary result is therefore expected ahead of the next examination stage.  The result is likely to be accessible through the candidate login facility. Applicants should keep their registration number or roll number and password or date of birth ready. How to check IBPS Clerk Preliminary result 2026
 Candidates can follow these steps after the result link is activated: Step 1: Visit the official website, ibps.in . Step 2: Open the CRP CSA-XVI section. Step 3: Click on the Preliminary Examination result status link. Step 4: Enter the required login credentials. Step 5: Submit the details to view the result. Step 6: Download and save the result for future reference. What happens after the Preliminary result? Candidates qualifying in the Preliminary examination will proceed to the Main examination. IBPS has scheduled the Main examination for December 27, 2026. The final selection process will follow the prescribed recruitment and provisional allotment procedures. Candidates should rely on the official IBPS website for the result link, scorecard, category-wise cut-offs and subsequent recruitment announcements.
